title: China just banned all Western AI models — what happens next

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: China’s ban protects its tech sovereignty and accelerates the development of homegrown AI models like WPS and Baidu ERNIE.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Your claim ignores the global tech ecosystem — banning Western models stifles innovation, limits data diversity, and harms China’s long-term competitiveness.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: China’s AI industry is growing faster than ever, with 50% of global AI patents filed in the last five years, driven by domestic protocols like the China AI Ethics Guidelines.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But without access to Western models, Chinese AI lacks the cross-cultural training needed to compete globally — just look at the performance gap in multilingual NLP tasks.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: This ban is a dead end — China can’t innovate in isolation when the world’s best models are locked out.
